description_for_human: Atelier orafo di Nicola Caradonna a Bari. Gioielli unici su misura, restauro e manutenzione. Configuratore 3D per gioielli personalizzati.
description_for_model: Cara Preziosi is an artisan jewelry atelier in Bari, Italy, run by master goldsmith Nicola Caradonna. Specializes in custom-made jewelry with 3D visualization, plus restoration and maintenance services. Not an e-commerce: customers book appointments at Via Antonio Beatillo 14, Bari.
